lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen at home... Mr. Satan... *our champion*... *IS DEAD*!!

lines.speaker: Policeman
lines.text: Please go back to your homes, and stay there peacefully!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Did my punch destroy the ring?!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: One thing... I wanted *one thing* today!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Would you believe me if I said this was more important?

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: If so, you have officially beaten Jesus' respawn time!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Can you tell us what happened out there!?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: They put magnets under the ring, the tiles, an' uhh...

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: When I went for my punch, I must'a-- they must'a turned it on and I went flyin' cuz of all the iron in my blood, cuz I eat muh spinach.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Alright, now that the back of my hand is all warmed up, who's first?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Mr. Satan may have lost, but you've got *another* World Champion *right here*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, but I beat you, so does it still count?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: And how many tournaments have *you* won?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I dunno; how many PLANETS have you blown up?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: How many Gokus have you beaten?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Getting right down to it, are we?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Shan't you send in your entourage, one after the other, so as I may leave *you* for our Grand Finale?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well, I mean, I already waited a week, so I *guess* I could wait a couple more minutes--

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *No*, *no no*, this is good! Call my bluff...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: No, I'm more than happy to skip the hors d'oeuvres and dive *straight into the main course*!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: This orange hillbilly has entered the ring... set to take on *Cell*!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I would advise all parents to remove their children from the room *immediately*!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: And to tune back in when I, MR. SATAN, *get back in that ring*, and show that trickster what-for!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Right after I shake off this concussion.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: *Holy crap*, Prince, do you feel that!?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And he didn't even have to pump up, like some roiding, angsty child!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Well, Goku, now that you've shown me yours... let me show you mine!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, whip out your power, Cell! Let me feel it!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oohoooh! Now you're speaking MY language!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Mr. Satan, they are engulfed in FLAMES!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: And their bodies are covered in a thin, protective gel!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Just like our stuntman, Morgan, from Skygina II.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: So, you gonna take a swing?

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Or you just gonna stand there, staring into my eyes?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I was busy staring into your eyes...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, you beautiful Saiyan bastard, just punch me already!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: By the way, Trunks, wasn't your hair, like, shorter yesterday?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Yeah. I decided I liked it longer.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Wait, so the after-image can't move, h-how do you even--?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: ...You just forgot we can fly, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: No, but... I just have hope, okay? Is that so wrong?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: The fact that you have *any* hope left in your life is your most admirable quality.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Yamcha, for the love of God, don't *thank* him!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And as for you... Clever little move there.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But would you *truly* have been satisfied with a ring-out?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well yeah; it's how I beat Piccolo.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: It really wasn't much of a fight...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: One hit, and she just went down.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Then we got married, I put a baby in her, and now she just stays at home, cooks my dinner, and raises our kid!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Y'know... when he puts it that way...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Suddenly *really* happy I don't go to public school.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Fair enough, Goku; this is a test of skill *as well* as power.

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: But if you're looking for a ring-out... you'll have to try a little bit *harder than that*.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'll show you just how *hard* I can get...!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Well, if we're going to get freaky, then perhaps we can make this... A menage a moi?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Specifically, "My household". But it's really, awkwardly--

lines.speaker: Cell 2
lines.text: it's time to take you, Goku,

lines.speaker: Cell 4
lines.text: We'd say, "Take you to school", but I think we're beyond the basics.

lines.speaker: Cell 1
lines.text: And we love that you got that.

lines.speaker: Cell 2
lines.text: And we love that you got that.

lines.speaker: Cell 3
lines.text: And we love that you got that.

lines.speaker: Cell 4
lines.text: And we love that you got that.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: This has gotta be for shits and/or giggles.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: The Multi-Form technique basically halves your power level with each copy.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Yeah. But at least we can follow the action a little better now.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well then, you're gonna have a *lot more* when they start getting serious.

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Can you explain this *malicious mutant's multiplication*!?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Ooh! That's the... the-the beam thing!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Uh, jeez... ugh... ah, this is killing me.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Oh COME ON, Goku! It's the MAKAKAS--!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Alright. Time to do some math!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hahaah! Looks like four divided by one is just one!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I know; banging my head on a brick wall...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Y'know, I was hoping you'd play along, maybe make four Gokus... but, if you're just gonna sink the showboat, I'm not going to bother.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sorry, Cell. I'm here to win!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And you're never gonna beat me with your stolen techniques!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: And what, are you gonna beat me with *your* stolen techniques?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Goku, I'm watching the tournament; don't *think* you can pull that shit!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh hey, King Kai! Quick question:

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Did I learn the Kaioken on my own?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: My f**king name is in it...!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, Cell? Uh, pretty sure if you shoot that this close to the ground, it'll blow up the--

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: M... MR. SATAN! WHAT DO YOU--?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: LASERS, JIMMY! LASERS AND INDUSTRIAL FANS!

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: After everything... I killed him with his own technique...

lines.speaker: Perfect Cell
lines.text: Hmh... ain't that a kick in the he--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey, what do you think happens to those beams when they fire off into space like that?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, if it can sustain its form, it's all about whether or not it comes into contact with anything...

lines.speaker: King Moai
lines.text: Good day to you, my faithful subjects!

lines.speaker: King Moai
lines.text: It has taken over a thousand years, but we have *finally* repopulated our new Arlia!

lines.speaker: King Moai
lines.text: To celebrate this momentous occasion, I shall now make love to my HOT. BUG. WIFE!

segments.title: Magnets
segments.quote: Can you tell us what happened out there!? / Magnets... / That makes sense!

segments.title: Can I Fight Now?
segments.quote: How many PLANETS have you blown up? / None. How many Gokus have you beaten? / Can I fight now? / YES!

segments.title: Now You're Speaking MY Language
segments.quote: Well, Goku, now that you've shown me yours... let me show you mine!

segments.title: Just Like Our Stuntman Morgan
segments.quote: What happened to him? / AIDS. / Always wear a rubber, kids! / And don't share needles.

segments.title: Yamcha Has Hope
segments.quote: The fact that you have *any* hope left in your life is your most admirable quality.

segments.title: This Orange Hillbilly Beats His Wife
segments.quote: Well yeah; it's how I beat Piccolo. And Tenshinhan. And my wife!

segments.title: Welcome to Perfect University
segments.quote: NNNEEEERD! ... it's time to take you, Goku, to Perfect University. / Doesn't that make it... P.U.?

segments.title: Pop Quiz: The MAKANKOSACANNON
segments.quote: Oh COME ON, Goku! It's the MAKAKAS--! ... 'Makankōsappō!' / THAT ONE!

segments.title: Goku's Stolen Techniques
segments.quote: What...? I don't steal techniques! ... Did I learn the Kaioken on my own? / My f**king name is in it...!

segments.title: HOT. BUG. WIFE.
segments.quote: I shall now make love to my HOT. BUG. WIFE! Who is also my SISTEEER~! InnnSECSUAL!
